user.title: Connect UNICO EVO locally
user.description: Connect directly using the local Tuya LAN protocol 3.4. The OS Home cloud is not required for normal operation.

data_description.host: Local address of the UNICO. A DHCP reservation is recommended.
data_description.device_id: Device ID obtained from your own OS Home setup.
data_description.local_key: Local Key obtained from your own device. Keep this value secret.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure UNICO connection
reconfigure.description: Update the network address or Local Key. The Device ID is the stable device identity and cannot be changed here.

data_description.host: Current local address of the UNICO.
data_description.local_key: Leave empty to keep the currently stored Local Key.

error.cannot_connect: Connection failed. Check the network address, Device ID and Local Key; temporarily close OS Home if necessary.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.reconfigure_successful: The UNICO connection settings were updated successfully.

reconnect_backoff.message: The UNICO is currently reconnecting. Try again shortly.
